events.did: Looked down and noticed a speck of blood on the back of his left hand
events.quote_anchor: Just then, he looked down, and noticed a speck of blood on the back of his left hand.

events.did: Vanished when Gabriel told him to show his power, his edges blurring and his body dissolving into the chair, the rug and the room
events.quote_anchor: And yet when the doctor told him to, Noah disappeared. He watched his edges blur, his body dissolving into the chair, the rug, the room, until he was invisible

events.did: Told Noah his power had remained remarkably intact, all things considered
events.quote_anchor: “Your power has remained remarkably intact, all things considered.”

events.did: Recoiled at his own reflection in the table because his brown eyes had swirled into green, white, blue and gray
events.quote_anchor: They had always been brown. But now, they swirled, the irises and whites both swallowed up by green and white and blue and gray—all the colors in the room.

events.did: Told Noah he had killed him and that it was a necessary step
events.quote_anchor: The doctor met his eyes, and smiled gently as he said, “I killed you.”

events.did: Told Noah that resurrecting someone gives him control over them and that Noah is the evidence it could be done
events.quote_anchor: “When I resurrect someone, I gain control over them. Humans return as little more than puppets. But the EOs have proven more resistant.

events.did: Drew the knife on command and pressed it into his own palm until blood welled, without hesitation
events.quote_anchor: He did, limbs moving before his mind had even processed the command. The blade sat open in his palm.

events.did: Refused for the first time to push the knife against Gabriel’s skin, saying he did not want to hurt him
events.quote_anchor: For the first time Noah felt himself resist. He brought the tip of the blade to the doctor’s palm, but he didn’t press down.

relations.did: Holds control over Noah through his resurrection, with Noah the first EO to come through it
relations.quote_anchor: But the EOs have proven more resistant. You’re the first one who’s come through it. You see, Noah. You are the evidence I needed.

relations.did: Reports that Agent Rios’s location is known but that Rios is not answering
relations.quote_anchor: “We have Agent Rios’s location,” she said. “But she’s not answering.”

relations.did: Warned Noah when he joined EON to use his ability only on a mission with his team, and even then only when necessary
relations.quote_anchor: The day he joined EON, Director Stell warned him to use his ability only when on a mission with his team and even then, only when necessary.

relations.did: Calmed Noah’s panic about his changed eyes with his voice, so the panic melted away
relations.quote_anchor: “Don’t worry,” said the doctor. The words landed like a blanket. Heavy. Welcome. And sure enough, the panic melted.
